== Overview ==

Mist of Death is a Tibia OT 8.6 open tibia server for old-school players who still want fast PvP, no-wipe persistence, rebirths, augmentation, tasks, live events, and returner-friendly setup routes. This wording comes from the recorded official website metadata.

Players searching for '''Mistofdeath''' usually want the official website, client download path, rules, rates, and whether the world is still active. See:
